observations: Electronic keyboard wrapped in clear plastic film.
Control panel with buttons, knobs, and a small digital display.
Watermark 'PROXY MUSICALS' visible on both photos.
The keyboard is positioned between other electronic keyboards and a guitar in a shop environment.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not power on or produce sound.
risks.proof: A video showing the device powered on and playing a scale or demo song.

risks.risk: Individual keys or buttons may be unresponsive or faulty.
risks.proof: A video of a chromatic scale being played across all keys.

risks.risk: The internal batteries may be dead or the power adapter may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the power adapter and a video of the unit running on battery.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a constant power source

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the keyboard powered on and playing a full scale to test all keys.
Photo of the power adapter and any included cables.
Photo of the back of the unit to check for ports and the battery compartment.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
